profile.headline: Experienced Firmware Engineer | Problem Solver | Cross-Functional | Communicator | Embedded Software
profile.summary:
Highly technical embedded firmware engineer with diverse experience in data storage, aviation, telecommunication, and more. Intellectually curious, always learning new things. Goal-oriented, self-starter, with knowledge of all phases of entire product life cycles including design, development, debug, test, and documentation. Tenacious problem solver with novel approaches. Versatile in board bring-up and chip testing. Eager to learn and mentor, work well in teams, experienced with embedded system architecture, and memory constrained systems.
Gallup Strength-finder: Strategic, Ideation, Command, Analytical, Activator.
SKILLS
Languages:	       C/C++, C#, Java, Assembly, Python, HTML
Version Controls:	PVCS, Visual SourceSafe
Bug trackers:	       Team Track, Serena Business Manager (SBM)
Processors:               ARM, TI DSP, Motorola 68000
Protocols:	               SCSI, SAS, SATA, ARINC429
Software Architecture: RTOS, multi-threaded kernel
Code Review:            Code Collaborator
Design Methodology:  Waterfall, Agile Trained
Tools:	                       In Circuit Emulators (ICE), logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, oscilloscopes

positions.description: Web Site designer and in charge of marketing

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
Tech Lead for an Embedded Software Team working in Telematics. 
CAN Bus, UDS, WiFi, Modem, Linux, ELD
Architecting solutions in ECU programming.
Working closely with customers to provide the best design for their needs.

positions.title: Senior Firmware Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description:
Additional training received:
Java Development from Intertech 
C# from New Horizons
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) from Intertech
Certified Professional Project Manager (CPPM) from University of St. Thomas 
Microsoft Project 1 and Microsoft Project 2
Embedded Linux class with Doulos

positions.title: Sr. Staff Firmware Engineer, embedded software
positions.description:
Firmware development for Hard Disc Drives (HDD), including drive tuning and customer code.

-Developed embedded code in “C” to identify defective areas on each drive, using HW channel features, in order to present defect free data to the customer. 

- As a firmware product lead I tracked and prepared HDD feature development on a cross-functional team. Debugged and packaged code for the various product phases, leading to a successful product launch of company’s first high-end small form factor drive (3.5”)

- Reduced drive test time by improving algorithms, saving the company thousands of dollar in manufacturing costs.

positions.title: Firmware Developer, embedded software
positions.description:
- Real Time code development in "C" for TI DSP.
- Red Hat Linux environment

positions.title: Firmware Design Engineer, embedded software
positions.description:
- Honeywell Commercial Flight Systems, Phoenix AZ
Lead small software team in the creation of real time data storage tool for flight simulator lab that would enable future data analysis, reducing lab time needed to debug firmware issues, and speeding development. Identified and debugged issues with the wire wrap board, learned SCSI in order to save data in real time, tested, and documented.

- Maxtor Corporation, Longmont CO - Data Storage
Designed and implemented multitasking kernel for SCSI controller
Board and customized processor bring-up

- Infinitec Network, Tulsa OK - Telecommunications
Adaptec Corporation, Longmont CO - Data Storage
Direct Measurement Corporation, Longmont CO - Flow Meters
Sony Data Storage Laboratory, Boulder CO - Data Storage
